points: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer, David slew two and thirty thousand of them and put garrisons in Syria, and the Syrians became his servants and brought gifts.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 18: The Victories of King David

points: David carried the gold and much brass back to Jerusalem, the brass out of which Solomon would later make the brazen sea, the pillars, and the vessels.

points: Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten the host of Hadarezer and sent his son to greet David and congratulate him.

points: Again the account states plainly that the Most High preserved David wherever he went, marking Him as the source of every victory.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 18: The Victories of King David

points: David reigned over all Israel and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
